dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three distinct 'O' shaped structures on the upper-left quadrant exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with a hard-edged gradient transition into dark core pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid-core clusters; most high-intensity pixels are distributed in thin, curvilinear paths forming the annuli rather than solid blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the leftmost 'O' ring, the adjacent 'C' ring, and the small 'O' ring immediately below them form a scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, asymmetrical low-intensity void is centered on the lateral midline, interrupting the continuity of the annular texture pattern.
